sections.heading: 1.5.1 Module 1 Comprehensive Knowledge Synthesis
sections.content:
Congratulations on finishing Module 1 of Python Essentials 1! Let us review the foundational concepts mastered:

1. Computer Architecture: Hardware only executes machine instructions composed of binary voltages.
2. High-Level Languages: Python bridges human problem solving and machine instructions through clear syntax.
3. The CPython Pipeline: Python code is compiled into bytecode (.pyc) and executed by the Python Virtual Machine (PVM).
4. The print() Function: Outputs string representations of data with customizable separators (sep) and line terminators (end).
5. Escape Sequences: Backslash notation (\n, \t, \", \\) provides powerful control over text rendering.

You are now fully prepared to tackle the Module 1 Section Assessment.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: What is the primary role of the Python Virtual Machine (PVM)?

options.text: To execute bytecode instructions on the host machine
To edit and format Python source files
To upload scripts to cloud repositories
To compile Python directly into C++ code

knowledgeChecks.explanation: The PVM is the runtime engine in CPython that interprets and executes bytecode instructions.

recap: Module 1 is complete! Proceed to the Module 1 Assessment to earn your verified checkpoint.
